violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: a container of yogurt in the refrigerator was 46ºF.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC stated the yogurt had been sitting out at room temperature about 30 minutes ago. Cool the yogurt down to 41º in the next 3 hours.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Cream cheese @ 61 F and milk @ 44 F in the 1 DR white Upright refrigerator/Freezer.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: The cream cheese was discarded, refrigerator unit ambient temperature was lowered. Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the chlorine (bleach ) solution was too high to register on the chlorine test strip paper , >200 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: EHS worked with the certified food manager to create a chlorine solution that was approximately 100 ppm when checked with the test strip. Maintain the concentration of chlorine SANITIZER@ solution at 50-200 ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Modification to Section 4-205.10 Equipment Certification
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The upright white refrigerator/Freezer unit is household use only, items in unit are not holding temperature of 41 F or below. The following items are intended for household use only and are not approved for use in a commercial food establishment:
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: Person in Charge has been asked to replace unit with commercial refrigeration unit. Food equipment that is certified or classified for sanitation by an American National Standards Institute (ANSI) accredited certification program will be deemed to comply with Parts 4-1 and 4-2 of this chapter. Food equipment in a food establishment shall be certified of classified by an ANSI-accredited certification program, an equivalent certification program, or approved by the Regulatory Authority before installation and/or use.
